rights: Original project illustrations generated from written project lore; no external photos or game sprites were imported.
workflow: ImageGen transparent still → selected native pixel source → SpriteCook upload → one animation per actor with Basic alpha removal → source foot alignment and padding → editable Aseprite frames/tags → deterministic PNG strips.
sourcePreparation: Nearest-neighbour fit to 128×160 for people and 128×128 for Pascal, binary alpha threshold96, 8px lower margin. Original ImageGen PNG preserved. Animation pixels are never rescaled.

actors.name: observer
actors.still_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single isolated production character sprite for the game 26063, a cozy Russian scientific weather campus. Full-body young adult weather observer, warm intelligent face, tousled dark brown hair, navy-blue hooded field jacket with narrow warm amber piping and a tiny generic cloud patch, ivory shirt, navy trousers, sturdy brown boots, small brown leather backpack. Compact expressive proportions like a beautifully crafted detailed pixel adventure game: head is about one quarter of total height, readable face, crisp stepped silhouette, restrained warm amber highlights and cool navy shadows, fine deliberate pixel clusters, NO smooth rendering or anti-aliasing. Side three-quarter view facing RIGHT, in a clear mid-WALK stride with one leg forward and one leg behind, arms gently swinging, hands empty; will be animated in a continuous walking loop. Exact character only, generous empty padding around all sides, entire feet and backpack visible. Fully transparent background with true alpha; no ground, no floor, no contact shadow, no vignette, no text, no frame, no labels, no other objects. Make subject suitable for a 96 by 128 pixel source after nearest-neighbor sizing. Preserve clear outline and restrained material detail, mature kind character not an infant, match rich navy-and-amber handcrafted pixel campus art.
